title: Attic Insulation Rebates in Los Angeles 2026: Up to $0.75 per Sq Ft from LADWP | HomePowerRebate
desc: LADWP pays $0.50 per square foot for attic insulation above R-19, plus an extra $0.25 launch special that it extended. Rules, documents and steps for Los Angeles homes.
h1: Attic Insulation Rebates in Los Angeles
lead: LADWP's Attic Insulation Rebate Program pays $0.50 per square foot for attic insulation above R-19, and says every participant keeps an extra $0.25 per square foot from its launch special. That is the most generous insulation rebate we found among the Los Angeles-area utilities.
cards_intro: These figures come from LADWP's Attic Insulation Rebate Program page, which we read on October 2, 2026. The program covers projects bought and installed on or after September 1, 2025, and it is for batt and roll insulation only.

cards.title: Above R-19
cards.note: The standard rate when the installed insulation is above R-19.

cards.title: R-19 or below
cards.note: Only when the attic has less than 24 inches of clearance and a higher R-value cannot be achieved.

cards.title: Launch special, extended
cards.note: LADWP says all participants continue to receive this extra amount on qualified attic insulation.

cards.title: Typical savings LADWP cites
cards.note: Depending on the size of the home and its location.

after_cards:
A worked example

Insulating 1,000 square feet of attic above R-19 earns 1,000 x $0.50 = $500, and with the extra $0.25 it is 1,000 x $0.75 = $750. At R-19 or below the rate is $0.30, or $0.55 with the extra. LADWP says funds are limited and the launch special could change, so confirm both rates the day you apply.
sections: LADWP's rebate table is for batt and roll insulation. The page does not list blown-in insulation, so if your contractor proposes blown-in, ask LADWP in writing whether it qualifies before you sign. That one question can decide whether you get the rebate.
What LADWP asks you to send

The list is longer than most: a paid itemized invoice, an installation contract with a licensed contractor if you did not install it yourself, the manufacturer's certificate of product rating, dated color photos of the attic from the same angle before and after, and a Los Angeles Building and Safety (LADBS) permit with a finaled status. Applications are mailed to LADWP Residential Services Unit, Attn: Attic Insulation Rebate Program, P.O. Box 51111, Room 1019, Los Angeles, CA 90051-0100, and must be postmarked within 12 months. Faxed or emailed applications are not accepted.

You must be an LADWP residential customer with an active electric account, or a verified property owner with proof of ownership. LADWP accepts detached single-family homes, duplexes and other attached homes, condos and townhomes, and apartment units. LADWP says you cannot receive more than one rebate for the same product from more than one California utility program, including Energy Upgrade California Home Upgrade, so do not double-dip.

LADWP runs this separately from its Consumer Rebate Program. Pasadena pays $0.10 per square foot for ceilings (Pasadena) and Burbank sets its attic amount on the application (Burbank), so LADWP's published rate is the highest and clearest. Los Angeles's average January low over 2015 to 2024 was 7.9°C, so the benefit is mostly in summer cooling, which is what LADWP's page stresses too.
Do it before you buy a heat pump

Insulate the attic first and let the installer size the heating and cooling system afterward. A well-insulated attic can mean a smaller unit. Seal air leaks around hatches, lights and wiring holes in the same visit, since batt insulation does not stop moving air. The federal 25C and 25D tax credits ended for spending after December 31, 2025.
claim_heading: How to claim the LADWP rebate
claim_steps: Check that LADWP is your electric utility, or that you are the verified owner of an LADWP-served property.
Measure the attic clearance. Plan for above R-19 unless there is less than 24 inches of clearance.
Take dated color photos of the attic before the work, from a fixed angle.
Have the batt and roll insulation installed under an LADBS permit and get the permit finaled, then take matching after photos.
Collect the paid invoice, contract, manufacturer's certificate of product rating and permit.
Mail everything, signed and dated, within 12 months of the purchase or installation date.
faq: How much does LADWP pay for attic insulation?
$0.50 per square foot above R-19 and $0.30 at R-19 or below, plus an extra $0.25 per square foot that LADWP says it extended for all participants.
LADWP's table covers batt and roll insulation only. Ask LADWP before buying blown-in.
Projects purchased and installed on or after September 1, 2025.
Dated color photos of the attic from the same angle before and after the installation.
Can I also claim another utility's rebate?
No. LADWP says you cannot receive more than one rebate for the same product from more than one California utility program.
